newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Auridiam eyes higher diamond production.
newsitem.headline: Auridiam eyes higher diamond production.

text.p: Auridiam Consolidated NL said on Monday it expects production from its River Ranch diamond mine in Zimbabwe to increase to at least 600,000 carats in 1997 from 474,000 in 1996.

"We already saw a 20-percent increase in production in the March quarter and April production was 47,00 carats," Linda Zeffert, Auridiam's company secretary, told Reuters. "Six hundred thousand (carats) is very achievable."
Zeffert said a third diamond scrubber would be installed at a diamond recovery plant by June, which would help in lifting production at the mine.
About 60 percent of the mine's production consists of gem-quality stones, which are sold at private tenders in Antwerp, she said.
The River Ranch mine is owned 50-50 by Auridiam and Redaurum Ltd.
